_doc: VTID-05183 — inputs of scripts/native/gen-tokens.mjs. Tokens are never edited in packages/tokens: change src/index.css / tailwind.config.ts (a Spotlight contract change) and regenerate.

excluded.--appilix-bottom-nav-height: Web layout hack: Appilix (web-view wrapper) bottom-bar height fallback; the native app has its own tab bar.
excluded.--appilix-bottom-nav-h: Web layout hack: alias of --appilix-bottom-nav-height for the Appilix web-view wrapper.
excluded.--orb-gap: Redeclared outside the token block for the Appilix ORB docking offset (web-view only); the token value in :root stays a token.
excluded.--maxina-orb-size: Web layout: Maxina intro-page ORB sizing on body.maxina-intro-page, not a design token.
excluded.--maxina-orb-gap: Web layout: Maxina intro-page ORB spacing on body.maxina-intro-page, not a design token.
excluded.--maxina-orb-slot: Web layout: computed Maxina intro-page ORB slot (calc of size and gap), not a design token.
excluded.--maxina-orb-content-gap: Web layout: Maxina intro-page ORB spacing on body.maxina-intro-page, not a design token.
excluded.--maxina-orb-caption-gap: Web layout: Maxina intro-page ORB caption spacing on body.maxina-intro-page, not a design token.
excluded.--tw-gradient-from: Tailwind internal: dark-mode overrides of palette gradient classes (from-*-50/100), a web-only fix-up.
excluded.--tw-gradient-via: Tailwind internal: dark-mode overrides of palette gradient classes (via-*-50/100), a web-only fix-up.
excluded.--tw-gradient-to: Tailwind internal: dark-mode overrides of palette gradient classes (to-*-50/100), a web-only fix-up.
excluded.--tw-gradient-stops: Tailwind internal: gradient stop list rebuilt by the dark-mode gradient fix-ups, web-only.

runtimeVars.--radix-accordion-content-height: Set by Radix Accordion at runtime for the accordion keyframes; not a token.
